title: Reproducibility Code for Diagnosing Algorithmic Bias in AI-Powered Hiring: Toward a Fairness-Aware Framework
description: Reproducibility code for the analysis stage associated with the 2026 IEEE ICMI paper 'Diagnosing Algorithmic Bias in AI-Powered Hiring: Toward a Fairness-Aware Framework'. The package reproduces data-level gender summaries, logistic-regression holdout fairness metrics (SR, TPR, FPR), fairness gaps, group-stratified bootstrap intervals, baseline regressions, figures, and machine-readable outputs from the cleaned datasets used in the authors' source notebook. Raw-to-clean preprocessing was not present in that notebook and is outside this package's reproducibility claim. Canonical repository: https://github.com/HairuFan/icmi-2026-algorithmic-bias-hiring. Zenodo DOI for version 1.0.0: 10.5281/zenodo.21894169.
